versions.changelog:
Initial release of Lokuli Booking skill for real-world service appointments.

- Enables searching, viewing, and booking 75+ local service types (e.g., plumbers, haircuts, mechanics)
- Supports availability checks, provider info, pricing estimates, and location validation
- Enforces explicit user confirmation before booking; collects required customer info
- Generates Stripe checkout URLs for secure payments
- Details full API with example JSON requests for all booking actions
